overview: This 401-page file traces Japan’s monetary and gold policies from 1930 to 1939, with particular attention to wartime finance. Diplomatic correspondence, consular reports, legislation, press extracts, and statistical tables document yen exchange policy, gold shipments to the United States, reserves, mining, currency issuance, and foreign trade.
interest: Detailed shipment records and statistical attachments let historians compare official gold figures with consular reporting during Japan’s wartime financial strain.
